title: Ember & Oak: Second Shop Launch

characters.name: The Roaster
characters.visual_lock: Adult roaster in their 40s, short salt-and-pepper hair, rolled-up chambray shirt, waxed canvas apron with a brass pin, burn scar on left forearm

characters.name: The Regular
characters.visual_lock: Adult neighborhood regular in their 20s, cycling cap, olive rain jacket, carries a dented enamel travel mug

locations.name: Original roastery, back room
locations.description: Small drum roaster, burlap coffee sacks stacked on a pallet, chalkboard roast log, one east-facing window

locations.name: Second shop, front counter
locations.description: Reclaimed oak counter, two-group espresso machine, hand-lettered window sign reading 'Now Open', street visible outside

visual_rules.lighting_key: Early morning natural sidelight from one window, warm practical bulbs, soft contrast, no hard rim light
visual_rules.style_prompt: 35mm documentary photograph, natural window light, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, muted earth tones
visual_rules.negative_prompt: lens flare, neon, oversaturated, plastic skin, cgi, 3d render, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, stock photo smile, lettering, signage, writing, outdoor kiosk

exclusions: No stock 'hipster barista' tropes or forced smiles
No claims we cannot source (no 'best coffee in town')
